scenes.audio: who receives benefits and important rights. Under Maryland’s employer group rule, this coverage benefits people other than the employer. It is different from a business buying key person coverage for its own loss.
scenes.label: Product Information

scenes.audio: Eligible employees may include all employees or qualifying classes. Read the policy’s eligibility terms rather than assuming that every worker, contractor or family member is automatically covered.

scenes.audio: or both. When employees contribute, the plan is contributory. When they do not, it is noncontributory. Maryland’s employer group rule generally requires coverage of all eligible employees in a noncontributory plan,

scenes.audio: except written rejections and the stated insurability exception. Covered arrangements may extend protection to a spouse, domestic partner or dependent children.

scenes.audio: The amount on a dependent cannot exceed the employee’s amount under the rule taught here. A dependent’s coverage and conversion rights require their own attention.

scenes.audio: an eligible insured obtain individual life coverage from the insurer without new evidence of insurability. The ordinary application and first premium deadline is 31 days after termination

scenes.audio: of employment or eligible membership. The available form is a form the insurer customarily issues, other than term insurance, subject to the stated conditions.

scenes.audio: Conversion preserves an opportunity for coverage, not the old group price.

scenes.audio: eligible for $30,000 under another group policy within the stated 31-day period. Under the Maryland conversion amount rule, the maximum is $50,000.
scenes.label: Product Information

scenes.audio: The statute also requires written notice of conversion rights and provides an extension when that notice is missing or late, within its outer limit.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: Static slide with three rectangles. High contrast text boxes.

scenes.audio: If an insured dies while entitled to convert but before the individual policy is effective, the amount available for conversion is payable under the group policy, even without the application or first premium.
scenes.label: Product Information

scenes.audio: or a covered class is removed. Instead of Marcus simply leaving his job, a separate Maryland provision addresses this event.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios

scenes.audio: It protects an insured who has been covered for at least five years before termination, subject to the conversion conditions.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios

scenes.audio: The policy may limit the individual amount to the lesser of the lost coverage after the specified new group offset or $10,000. Do not apply this five-year requirement and possible cap to every ordinary employment termination conversion question.
